correctness.rationale: The cited manifold theorem applies to simplex dimension p+q+2 and gives connectedness for p,q≥1. A ridge has two unused labels u,v. In the deficient factor orient its two extensions by putting the inserted label first; the deletion signs then agree (including the common product factor for a deletion in the second factor), whereas the full words differ by transposing the inserted and unused labels. The signed coefficients cancel. The all-unit cycle is primitive and generates integral top homology on the connected closed manifold. Relabeling multiplies the full-word sign by the permutation sign; the two signs for sorting the factors cancel against the induced orientations. For p=q=d the product orientation contributes (−1)^(d²) under swap and the full word contributes (−1)^((d+1)²), whose product is −1. Disjoint supports exclude fixed points. A free orientation-reversing PL involution gives a nonorientable connected closed PL quotient.
